_comment: ⚠️  PLACEHOLDER — Replace with your real google-services.json from Firebase Console
_instructions: PHASE 3 SETUP — follow docs/FIREBASE_SETUP.md for full walkthrough
2. Select or create project (project_id should be 'predictxta-c6bcb' or similar)
5. NEVER commit the real file to git
6. Upload to EAS: eas secret:create --name GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON --value @./google-services.json --type file
7. Verify: eas secret:list → shows GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON (type: file)
REQUIRED FIELDS that must be real (non-placeholder):
project_number: numeric string from Firebase project settings
client_id (type 3): Web client ID for Google Sign-In
current_key: Android API key from Firebase
After EAS build, add SHA-1 to Firebase:
Firebase Console → Project Settings → Your Android app → Add fingerprint
